recovery_password_notify_ck_notify_metho.name: recovery_password_notify_ck_notify_method
recovery_password_notify_ck_notify_metho.value: (phone_by_entity_id IS NOT NULL) OR (email_by_entity_id IS NOT NULL)

entity_ck_fusion.name: entity_ck_fusion
entity_ck_fusion.value: ((fusion_master_entity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (fusioned_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((fusion_master_entity_id IS NULL) AND (fusioned_at IS NULL))

department_ck_fusion.name: department_ck_fusion
department_ck_fusion.value: ((entity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_id IS NULL) AND (parent_id IS NOT NULL))

branch_ck_parent.name: branch_ck_parent
branch_ck_parent.value: ((entity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_id IS NULL) AND (parent_id IS NOT NULL))

branch_ck_subsidiary.name: branch_ck_subsidiary
branch_ck_subsidiary.value: ((subsidiary_id IS NULL) AND (annulled_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((subsidiary_id IS NOT NULL) AND (annulled_at IS NULL))

source_type_verification_method_ck_activ.name: source_type_verification_method_ck_active_status
source_type_verification_method_ck_activ.value: ((is_active = true) AND (annulled_at IS NULL)) OR ((is_active = false) AND (annulled_at IS NOT NULL))

registration_source_verification_ck_used.name: registration_source_verification_ck_used
registration_source_verification_ck_used.value: (used_at IS NULL) OR ((used_at IS NOT NULL) AND (used_at <= expired_at))

osbs.view_entity_master.name: view_entity_master
osbs.view_entity_master.definition: WITH RECURSIVE entity_master AS ( SELECT ent.id AS root_id, ent.id AS entity_id, ent.system_subscription_id, ent.is_natural, ent.identity_document, ent.name, ent.created_at, ent.updated_at, ent.annulled_at, ent.deleted_at FROM tenants.entity ent WHERE ent.fusion_master_entity_id IS NULL AND ent.annulled_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ent.id AS root_id, mas.entity_id, mas.system_subscription_id, mas.is_natural, mas.identity_document, mas.name, mas.created_at, mas.updated_at, mas.annulled_at, mas.deleted_at FROM tenants.entity ent JOIN entity_master mas ON mas.entity_id = ent.fusion_master_entity_id AND mas.annulled_at IS NULL AND ent.annulled_at IS NULL ) SELECT root_id, entity_id, system_subscription_id, is_natural, identity_document, name, created_at, updated_at, annulled_at, deleted_at FROM entity_master
